scope.positive: Owner-reviewable implementation and dry-run evidence for the bounded framed-range lifecycle, cold handoff abstraction, atomic resume, rollback and fixture heavy lease.
scope.negative: This proposal is not operator approval, parent-restream authorization, a production lease, an official Xet body transfer, GLM capability evidence or permission to retain parent bytes.

official_range_executor.role: owner-gated official hf_xet ordered-range producer and Ed25519-attested restart authority

green_fixture_contract: exact bounded WINDOW -> ordered RANGE -> END_WINDOW parsing
per-range SHA-256 and cumulative 64-KiB-rounded source accounting before staging
complete component sum equals declared incremental bytes and never exceeds 90,000,000,000 bytes
live free-byte minus exact incremental byte admission remains above the single protected floor
fresh floor checks run before, during and after each streamed range and before handoff; child stdout/stderr collectors are bounded
a fixed OS Ed25519 owner trust anchor carries a signed single-use launch claim atomically into executor STARTED state
every resumable window receipt is Ed25519-attested and binds launch nonce, lease identity, operator executable and predecessor receipt
deterministic one-pass fixture processing and verified cold-store SHA-256
immediate source-range eviction, local artifact eviction and no fixture cache or Trash creation
atomic terminal receipt resume and partial-staging recovery
rollback after range, pack, handoff and terminal-receipt failure
exclusive fixture lease, heartbeat freshness, unlocked-stale-record recovery marker, contention labels and foreign-process refusal

controller_verification.result: 19 current authorization/range tests pass; broader fixture/operator/controller/lease suite remains required after any owner-approved executable is supplied
controller_verification.adversarial_challenge: Independent challenge forged a substitute FINAL_PREFLIGHT and unkeyed resume receipt and identified unbounded child logs/mid-window floor drift. The current mechanism rejects both forgeries, caps output, and resamples the floor at each range boundary.

owner_review_questions: Approve or reject the exact production operator executable by byte SHA-256.
Approve the operator's 32-byte Ed25519 receipt-attestation public key and retain its private key outside the repository.
Approve the real remote cold-storage backend, namespace, credentials boundary and remote hash API.
Approve the production GPU lease identity and foreign-process policy.
Confirm that the production operator replaces the fixture pack with probe, teacher capture and executable one-pass Gravity packing without weakening any receipt field.
Confirm rollback retention and remote-object deletion policy for every injected failure stage.
reopen_conditions: Any implementation or dependency byte changes after approval.
Any unaccounted source, artifact, metadata, cache, Trash or rollback byte.
Any missing remote SHA-256 verification or predecessor terminal receipt.
Any production run under a fixture lease, contended label or foreign process.
Any attempt to execute before D5/D8/D9, parent authorization, production lease and operator approval gates pass.
